script: Most broken players in FIFA Ultimate Team history. So there's this striker named Joselu, and in real life nobody rated him. He bounced around from Stoke to Deportivo to Newcastle to Alavés without ever really becoming a star anywhere, just your average journeyman forward. But the version of him that lived inside FIFA twenty-one played by a completely different set of rules. His base gold card was rated seventy-six playing for Alavés in the Spanish league, and the price was only around four hundred to seven hundred coins, which is basically nothing. That's the kind of card you'd normally throw away instantly, and his pace was only fifty-six. So on paper he looked slow and useless. Most people in FIFA twenty-one wanted fast forwards who could dribble past anyone, and Joselu was the complete opposite of that. But the coins you spent on him told you nothing about what this card was about to do to your opponents. Joselu was six foot four with a big tall frame, and his shooting stats were quietly insane for the price, with eighty finishing, seventy-nine positioning, seventy-eight shot power, and eighty-one heading. So the second the ball came near the box off a cross or a cutback, this man buried it, and players were logging almost one goal per game with him across thousands of matches. So while everyone else was spending millions of coins chasing Ronaldo, the smartest FIFA players were quietly finishing games with a five hundred coin nobody from Alavés.
